reasoning: This is a direct application of the Pigeonhole Principle. We have 21 pigeons and only 20 holes, with each hole allowed to contain AT MOST ONE pigeon. The maximum number of pigeons that can be placed under these constraints is 20 (one per hole). Since 21 > 20, it is mathematically impossible to assign all 21 pigeons to 20 holes without putting at least two pigeons in the same hole. Therefore, no valid assignment exists and the problem is UNSATISFIABLE.
